description: Biogasanlagen im Freistaat Sachsen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Data on biogas plants in the Free State of Saxony that are or are not covered by Annex I No 5.3(b)(i) ) under the Industrial Emissions Directive 2010/75/EU. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Biogas plants in the Free State of Saxony" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Biogas, opendata, Biogasanlage, Biogaserzeugung, Gaserzeugung, Produktions- und Industrieanlagen. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
